{{recipesummary|category=Rice recipes|servings=8|time=1 hour|difficulty=3}}
{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|American cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Beans|Beans]] | [[Cookbook:Rice|Rice]]

==Ingredients==
* 6 slices [[Cookbook:Bacon|bacon]], diced
* 1 medium [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], [[Cookbook:Dice|diced]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] diced [[Cookbook:Celery|celery]]
* ½ cup diced [[Cookbook:Bell Pepper|bell pepper]]
* 4½ cups [[Cookbook:Water|water]]
* 2 packs long grain rice (3–4 cups cooked)
* 3 cans black-eyed peas
* 3 [[Cookbook:Jalapeño|jalapeños]], seeded and diced (about ½ cup)

==Procedure==
# Brown bacon in large [[Cookbook:Dutch Oven|Dutch oven]], remove, and reserve 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tablespoons]] of grease in pan.
# Add onion, celery, and bell pepper, and [[Cookbook:Sauté|sauté]] 5 minutes.
# Add rice and seasoning packet, water, and black-eyed peas; cover and [[Cookbook:simmer|simmer]] 25 minutes.
# Add bacon and jalapeños, cover and heat 5–10 minutes more.

==See also==
* [[Cookbook:Hopping John with Pinto or Great Northern Beans]]
